description: The compact handoff a warmup session produces for the steps that follow it. Every later step runs in its own context, so what warmup learned reaches them only through this document. Its bounds are deliberate: a handoff that repeats the sources it was distilled from costs more to carry than reading them again.

conventions.description: Rules a change must follow that are not obvious from the code.

entry_points.description: Where work on this repository usually starts, one per entry.

open_questions.description: What warmup could not settle and the next step should not assume.

sources.description: Paths this handoff was distilled from, so a later step can read one directly instead of searching.

summary.description: What this project is and how it is built, in prose.
